sentences.text: With the wind blowing onto the dock, stop parallel a few feet off and let the wind set you gently alongside.
With the wind blowing off the dock, approach at a steeper angle, get a bow line or spring line on quickly, and use it to pull the boat in.
A current from ahead is easiest to dock against, while a current from astern pushes you faster than you think, so turn around if you can.
To leave, motor gently ahead against a bow spring with the wheel turned toward the dock to swing the stern out, then back away.
